**Finding: Compliant** (rule MFN — Most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer)

The agreement contains no MFN provision at all, which satisfies the preferred position: no MFN obligation on Clear Capital.

What I checked:
- **§ 3 (Contractor's Compensation)** — the planner's candidate section — covers only time-and-materials compensation, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail, a rate-change notice right, and taxes. No best-pricing or third-party-matching mechanics.
- **Full-text searches** for "most favoured/most favored", "no less favo(u)rable", "best pricing", "favoured customer", "favorable", and "match" returned zero hits.
- **All remaining sections** (Preamble, § 1 Purpose, § 4 Ownership/Acceptance, § 5 Warranties, § 6 Termination, § 7 Liability/Indemnification) contain no MFN-type language.

No redline proposed. This is a clean pass at the preferred position rather than the fallback, so there is no residual 12-month/defined-product/carve-out analysis to run.

One item noted in the rationale but deliberately **not** flagged under this rule: § 3(b) gives Contractor the right to change rates on 30 days' notice to Company. That is a price-increase/uplift concern belonging to the pricing rule, not an MFN obligation running against us — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
